name: stories-skill
description: Tells short, gentle, child-friendly stories and bedtime tales, optionally about a topic you choose.

intents.description: Ask for a story, a bedtime story, or a short tale, optionally about a chosen character or topic.
example_utterances: Tell me a story about a brave little rabbit
Can you tell a short tale?
Tell my kid a story about the moon
I want a story about friendship
